description: This file defines the Tabs2 class, which extends TabActivity and implements TabHost.TabContentFactory. It sets up a tabbed UI with three tabs, some with icons, and provides content for each tab via the createTabContent method.

classes.name: Tabs2
classes.description: Main class demonstrating the use of tab content factory with tabs, including setting icons and labels on tabs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the tab activity, adding three tabs with specified indicators and content.

parameters.name: savedInstanceState
parameters.description: Array of key-value pairs used to restore the previous state of the activity.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates and returns the content view for a tab based on its tag, here a simple TextView with content indicating the tab's tag.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The identifier for the tab whose content is to be created.
